fit_reason: Whole 16-foot runabout with outboard and trailer, listed under boats by owner by a private seller on consignment.
findings: Hull gelcoat/paint on the port side looks clean but somewhat flat in sheen rather than high gloss
Light dust and dirt on the lower hull near the trailer bunks
Scuff on the top of the Chrysler outboard cowling near the front edge
Dusty, worn-looking carpet on the cockpit floor near the helm
Cockpit cluttered with bunched-up cover and loose gear in the photos
message: Hi Richard, we saw your listing for the restored 1967 Hall-Craft. It already shows well, but a wash and wax to bring more gloss to the hull, plus a quick cockpit carpet clean and a touch-up on the scuff on the outboard cowling, would help the photos pop. We do pre-sale details and come to you. Would you like a quote?
